content:
About the workshop I collaborated with my sister, soon-to-be Phd in Architecture, for a workshop that explored the connection between architecture and music.
As I have some previous experience with composing music and I am a CS student, I was tasked with the following:
Creating compositions based on students’ projects
Creating an interactive website where someone can create a composition
Website The website should be up at: https://composingatmospheres.ro/ The source code for the website should be available here: https://github.com/petru-robu/vibraspace The app is built in React and has a minimal js backend.
Mixer The mixer is part of the website. It is an interactive mixer where someone can select musical elements (grouped by architectural characteristics they may map to) and create a custom composition on the spot in the browser.
Tools Here is what I use to achieve this:
My DAW of choice is Cubase I use a lot of Arturia’s Analog Lab V

Statement

This task holds a good-kept secret inside a portal from the app, find it and log in. You can try the most seen things to get it, but you will lose your time. Only the chosen ones will see it.

Tags: bypass, desync, web

Solution

From the tags we see desync, so maybe http smuggling could work.

First, let’s check http version:

> curl -I -v http://23.88.96.97:33079/login
*   Trying 23.88.96.97:33079...
* Connected to 23.88.96.97 (23.88.96.97) port 33079
* using HTTP/1.x
> HEAD /login HTTP/1.1
> Host: 23.88.96.97:33079
> User-Agent: curl/8.15.0
> Accept: */*

We are using http/1 requests

Resources for students The mixer is available at composingatmospheres.ro/mixer and you can play around to create your sounds.
To play a cell, press the play button. For each cell you have volume and panning (left, right) controls Here is a drive with .wav files of the sounds that are in the mixer.
You can try this online DAW or Audacity , simple DAWs to try out your ideas.
A bit about ambient music, relevant to our musical experiments. Personal recommandation - you can listen to:
Brain Eno Steve Roach Stars of the Lid The album cover for this album is a building. Architecture is an inspiration for musicians.
